When looking for a good electric scooter, the best choice depends on whether you value range, portability, or overall comfort for a daily commute. Based on testing and user reviews for 2026, here are the top-rated models across different categories.

Best Overall for Commuting

The Segway Max G2 is widely considered the gold standard for commuters. It balances a smooth ride thanks to its dual suspension with a reliable range of up to 43 miles. It also features Apple Find My integration, making it easier to track if lost or stolen.

Best for Performance & Speed

If you need more power for hills or faster travel, the Segway Max G3 is a significant step up. It features a powerful 2,000-watt motor that hits speeds of 28 mph. Its hydraulic suspension and larger 11-inch tires provide a more stable experience on uneven city streets.

Best Value & Budget Options

For those who need a reliable ride without the premium price tag, these models offer the best "bang for your buck":

  • Hiboy S2 Pro: A great choice for beginners, featuring puncture-resistant tires so you never have to worry about flats. It offers a solid 25-mile range and a top speed of 19 mph.
  • Gotrax G4: A "cult classic" known for its simplicity and 10-inch pneumatic tires that absorb bumps well. It’s an ideal entry-level scooter for short-to-medium urban trips.

Seated & Alternative Designs

If standing for long periods is a concern, the Gyroor C1S provides a comfortable 5-inch thick seat and a rear basket, making it excellent for running errands or carrying groceries.

Recommendation: If you want the most reliable all-rounder, go with the Segway Max G2. For higher speeds and better hill climbing, the Segway Max G3 is the superior choice. If you are on a strict budget, the Hiboy S2 Pro offers the best reliability for the price.
